Required Qualifications 

 Leadership Experience 
 10+ years of progressive software engineering experience.
 5+ years leading engineering organizations, technical programs, or transformation initiatives.
 Proven experience managing multiple engineering teams across locations and disciplines.
 Demonstrated success delivering large-scale enterprise technology transformation programs.
 AI & Automation 
 Experience implementing Applied AI, Generative AI, or intelligent automation solutions in enterprise environments.
 Strong understanding of: Large Language Models (LLMs)
 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

 Conversational AI platforms

 -Experience measuring, optimizing, and scaling automation programs.
 Application Development 
 Deep expertise with: Java
 Spring Boot
 Spring Security
 Spring Cloud
 Spring Data

 Strong hands-on development experience and willingness to remain engaged technically.
 Integration & Distributed Systems 
 Experience building large-scale distributed systems and enterprise integrations.
 Expertise with: API design and governance
 Event-driven architecture
 Kafka and/or RabbitMQ
 OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect
 Kubernetes and Docker
 
 Proven success integrating complex enterprise applications and platforms.
 Agile & Delivery 
 Experience leading teams operating in Agile delivery environments.
 Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, release management, and operational excellence..
